_about: Which copy assignment is right, per poster, as judged by eye on overlay.py. 'golden' names it: 'stored' (the solution in the site), 'baseline' (tests/regress_baseline.json), or null when neither is right. The stored solutions were made with in-progress or ad-hoc code, so 'stored' is a target for the tool, not something it once did. Judged 2026-09-24.
